title: Business-Wrap service record (evidence input)
description: The facts a form crawl and a process model cannot show, each traceable to a source. Written by hand from a named document, or by an importer: engine/harvest/record.mjs recordFromPage() turns a dump of the back-office request-type page into THIS shape (source.kind record-page; build --record-page), walkFromScreens() turns a recorded desk walk into a bw-walk (build --walk), engine/harvest/previous.mjs reads an earlier document (build --previous). engine/srs reads it. Every text value is a string (both languages) or {ar, en}.

key.description: the stable key the process is known by (never a name fragment)

source.description: the default source of every fact

facts.description: An empty list means «stated: none» and prints «none»; a missing key means «not known» and becomes an open question.

preview.description: data: URI or file of the captured output (viewport shot)

masked.description: the preview's data is masked; an unmasked preview is never printed (healer output-image)

slas.description: stated durations (e.g. the system variables page). A model timer written as an expression (${edit_duration}) takes the target of the row whose variable, or whose stage text names that variable

desks.description: the desk walk, keyed by the model's task name (or id): what each stage's screen shows and offers

name.description: the desk's own name on the back office (the stage name when no walk or names file gives one)

observed.description: true when the action bar was seen on a filed request; only then do its captions bind as verbatim

returned.description: the retrieved data the screen shows (story contract)

displayCriteria.description: when the request shows at this stage (story contract)

earlierIssue.description: the issues on record before this one, oldest first (the lineage): the revisions table prints them, then this issue, capped at versioning.maxRows; last row = issue date = cover version

preparedBy.description: who prepared THIS service's document (wins over the earlier document and the profile)

filedSerial.description: the serial of a request actually filed: the service code must be part of it (healer record-present)

feeCodes.description: fee codes as the back office lists them (record page)

validity.description: output validity as the back office states it (record page)
